clips.title: The story
paras: In Deathknell, the Hallowed Scroll calls newly awakened Forsaken priests to the ruined chapel. Sealed by Dark Cleric Duesten, it begins their training in faith, willpower, and shadow.

Newly risen Forsaken priests feel their bond with the world change violently. As Deathknell is reclaimed amid ongoing chaos, the Hallowed Scroll sends them to seek guidance in the settlement’s ruined chapel. Dark Cleric Duesten’s seal marks the parchment. It introduces the new priests to formal instruction and directs them to report for it, beginning their study of the practical beliefs that shape Forsaken priesthood.

Dark Cleric Duesten tells priests who answer the summons to leave old teachings behind. The Holy Light, ancestral spirits, and demonic pacts cannot be their crutches. Instead, the scroll begins a discipline grounded in each priest’s own will. Its teachings call on them to survive and rule through conviction, making faith a means of self-command and mastery.
